config.name: Applications
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    Attributes['name'] AS app,
    argMax(Attributes['sync_status'], TimeUnix) AS sync_status,
    argMax(Attributes['health_status'], TimeUnix) AS health_status,
    argMax(Attributes['operation'], TimeUnix) AS operation,
    argMax(Attributes['autosync_enabled'], TimeUnix) AS autosync,
    argMax(Attributes['project'], TimeUnix) AS project,
    argMax(Attributes['dest_namespace'], TimeUnix) AS dest_namespace
  FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'argocd_app_info' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY app
)
SELECT count() AS "Applications" FROM latest

config.name: Sync status over time
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
  Attributes['sync_status'] AS "Sync status",
  countDistinct(Attributes['name']) AS "Applications"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'argocd_app_info' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, "Sync status"
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Applications
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    Attributes['name'] AS app,
    argMax(Attributes['sync_status'], TimeUnix) AS sync_status,
    argMax(Attributes['health_status'], TimeUnix) AS health_status,
    argMax(Attributes['operation'], TimeUnix) AS operation,
    argMax(Attributes['autosync_enabled'], TimeUnix) AS autosync,
    argMax(Attributes['project'], TimeUnix) AS project,
    argMax(Attributes['dest_namespace'], TimeUnix) AS dest_namespace
  FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'argocd_app_info' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY app
)
SELECT
  app AS "Application",
  project AS "Project",
  dest_namespace AS "Namespace",
  sync_status AS "Sync",
  health_status AS "Health",
  autosync AS "Auto-sync"
FROM latest
ORDER BY sync_status = 'Synced' ASC, health_status = 'Healthy' ASC, app ASC

config.name: Reconciliation p95
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  if(idx = 0 OR length(bounds) = 0, 0, bounds[least(idx, length(bounds))]) AS "p95 (s)"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    bounds,
    arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= arraySum(counts) * 0.95, arrayCumSum(counts)) AS idx
  FROM (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
      any(ExplicitBounds) AS bounds,
      sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS counts
    FROM default.otel_metrics_histogram
    WHERE MetricName = 'argocd_app_reconcile' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    GROUP BY ts
  )
)
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Reconciliations/s
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  greatest(max(total) - min(total), 0) / $__interval_s AS "Reconciliations/s"
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, TimeUnix, sum(Count) AS total
  FROM default.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE MetricName = 'argocd_app_reconcile' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, TimeUnix
)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Errors & warnings
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts,
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS "Component",
  count() AS "Errors"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'argocd'
  AND lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'warn', 'warning', 'fatal')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY ts, "Component"
ORDER BY ts
